svg.title: Biased heterojunction: bands, two chemical potentials, two currents
svg.text: Biased heterojunction: bands, two chemical potentials, two currents
Synthetic A/B, 300 K, fixed positive sheet; ideal zero-resistance interface; right V = -20 mV
Quasi-Fermi levels: continuous at ideal interface
Net bulk SRH: positive means recombination
